required_behaviors: Consume exactly job_count triples after the standard body and reject all missing or trailing tokens.
Validate each job-local loop boundary and repeat count against the original route.
Expand every route as pre plus loop_body repeated repeat times plus post before search.
Assign continuous expanded op_id values and preserve independent machine choice per pass.
Construct and fully decode every expanded operation under job precedence and machine capacity.
Reject partial, duplicate, original-route-only, or stale cached schedules before scoring.
Use at least one bounded repeated-pass-aware pressure in construction or search.
Retain complementary generic FJSP rules and complete fixed-evaluator verification.

coupled_groups.rule: Parsing, expanded identities, decoding, search, and output coverage must describe the same expanded route.
